scripts.test:qa: npm run test:data && npm run test:tokens && npm run test:visual
scripts.update-upstream: cd stackrox-upstream && git pull origin master
scripts.clone-upstream: rm -rf stackrox-upstream && git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/stackrox/stackrox.git stackrox-upstream
